title: San Francisco minted just 24 dimes in 1894; 9 survive, and one sold for $1.25 million in 2026
summary_full: A rare 1894-S Barber dime has just sold for over one million dollars, reflecting its extraordinary scarcity. Out of the original twenty-four minted in San Francisco, only nine have survived to present day. This coin, steeped in historical intrigue, stands as a numismatic gem and an investment of significant worth due to its limited supply.
